digest.component_or_area: Plan Review T10 (Overlay Infrastructure) Rubric and Eval Spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments with an exact scope clause stating the boundary.

T10 must retain all four MAJOR safety classes (destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, endpoint-auth) for transient infrastructure via an exact co-located qualifier immediately after the scope clause.
T10 must not reference T15 or delegate scope to any other overlay, maintaining independent evaluation criteria.

The packaged eval spec must contain ten balanced dataset cases (five pass, five finding) covering transient lifecycle safety and durable infrastructure lifecycle safety with matching gold_set entries.
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause wording, exact safety qualifier wording, exact adjacency, and rubric independence via direct assertion.
